text:
Lina P.: hey @people-ops — quick onboarding/security q. I enrolled my Mac but FileVault shows "pending" in the MDM console and my phishsim training link didn't arrive. Also I need temporary access to a Windows test VM for a customer demo later this week. Who should I ping to get these unblocked? :wave:
People Ops: welcome Lina! :tada: For FileVault first try a re-enroll, sometimes the MDM profile didn't finish. If that doesn't update, open a ticket with IT and include the serial number.
Maya (it-support): hi @Lina P. please run `sudo fdesetup status` and paste the output here. If it says "Encrypted" we're good; if "Not Encrypted" we'll push a reprovision. Also check your email (including spam) for the phishsim invite — training is auto-assigned once your account is fully enrolled.
Lina P.: output is: `FileVault is On.` Hmm the MDM console still shows pending. spam checked.
Maya (it-support): ok that means FileVault finished locally. We need to refresh the MDM UI — re-sync should fix it. I can force a refresh if you open a ticket with the serial # (or ping me here and I'll do it). For phishsim I'll resend the training invite now.
sec-bot: PhishSim: scheduled simulation for new-hires group — training email resent to Lina P. (id: PS-4782)
People Ops: for the Windows test VM, we request standard temporary access via the infra loaner pool. @alex i can add Lina to the request if you confirm the time window.
Alex I.: @Lina P. send me the demo time & any special ports needed. We'll provision a VM for up to 72 hours. Note: contractors need approval from your manager for outbound network exceptions; full-time employees get default outbound.
Jordan S.: quick note on secrets/KMS — if your demo needs access to staging keys, we need a short-lived role. @Lina P. include the repo or service name in the ticket and we'll scope a role for the session.
Lina P.: thanks all — serial is C02XQ0ABCDEF, demo is Thurs 10am PT, no special ports. Putting service name in the ticket: `staging-demo-runner`.
Maya (it-support): got it, creating ticket IT-9456 to refresh MDM and re-send enrollment. Adding VM request to INFRA-3321.
People Ops: adding checklist for you: 1) confirm FileVault locally (`sudo fdesetup status`) 2) if UI pending, ticket IT-9456 3) confirm phishsim email (we resent) 4) request loaner VM (INFRA-3321) 5) if you need KMS access, include service name (Jordan will scope). Ping here if anything urgent. :thumbsup:
Lina P.: perfect — appreciate the fast help!
